ADBE.metric: GAAP net income; four-quarter totals spaced one year apart; USD billions
ADBE.forecast_definition: Total GAAP net income for the next four fiscal quarters following the latest reported quarter shown, relative to the latest displayed four-quarter annual total. Identify quarters by fiscal sequence; actual future quarter-end days may differ for 52/53-week fiscal years.
